meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, let's start. Ravi, how is the build going?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Mixed. The booking screens work against the test data. But the integration with the doctor schedule system is slower than I thought.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Is that the old system from the IT team?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. Right now their API only gives us a nightly export. They're adding a live endpoint, but not before the end of February.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: That affects the launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: It does. Honestly, the date we picked at kickoff won't work. I need about two weeks after their endpoint is live.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Better late than double bookings.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: I don't love it, but okay. We push the Andheri launch to the fifteenth of March. Everyone okay with that?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. I'll update the Andheri manager.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sofia
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine with me.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: While we're on the schedule system: where do the slots come from?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: I want one source of truth. The hospital's schedule system already has every doctor's sessions. If we keep our own copy, the two will drift apart.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Doctors will only update one place. They won't update two.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: So the existing doctor schedule system is the source of truth for appointment slots.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Front desk question. When a patient phones to cancel, can we cancel for them in the app? Many elderly patients will just call.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Sure, with a staff login.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. The front desk can cancel appointments on a patient's behalf.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Thank you. That saves a lot of trouble.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Kiran, you had a concern about the languages?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: The Hindi on the first screens reads like a machine translated it. Some of it is funny, to be honest.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: It was machine translated. We'll fix it.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: My front desk staff can check every Hindi screen before launch. They talk to patients all day.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Good. So the front desk staff check every Hindi screen before launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll send them the screens in a spreadsheet.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Dr. Mehta
meeting_transcripts.content: Someone suggested a chatbot for common questions, parking, timings and so on. Could we add one?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Not now, please. That's another project.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's keep it on the wish list.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Sofia
meeting_transcripts.content: Quick one from me: the Razorpay test account is ready.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Got it, thanks. I'll wire it up this week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Also, the Andheri manager asked whether the app will show the doctor's photo.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: We have photos for about half of them. I'd leave that for later.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine, later. Anything else? No? Thanks, everyone.
